VIKKI CARR is hailed as one of the top, new international cabaret
artists. She has appeared at London's ‘Talk Of The Town’, ‘The
Cocoanut Grove' in Los Angeles, 'The Sands’ in Las Vegas and ‘The
Persian Room’ in New York. She has made regular appearances on all
the major television shows in America, recorded three “VIKKI CARR
SHOWS” for BBC Television in Britain and has had to refuse offers
for a starring role in a Broadway musical due to her solidly booked
schedule.

Born of Mexican-American parents in El Paso, Texas VIKKI grew
up speaking Spanish before she could speak English and singing in
both languages for her family. At school and college she sang in the
choirs and with instrumental combos for evening dances. After grad-
uation VIKKI joined a Mexican-Irish band and sang her way through
Reno, Las Vegas, Lake Tahoe and Hawaii before recording a demon-
stration disc which she took to LIBERTY RECORDS. Her first single {
secured modest success in the U.S.A. and became a huge hit in
Australia which resulted in her first foreign tour. Since then her sub-
sequent singles and albums have registered strong sales both at home
and abroad.

The petite, vivacious VIKKI CARR is now in frequent demand not
only in America but throughout much of the world. Home is in Beverly
Hills, California, with her law student husband and “a rather spoilt
Yorkshire terrier", but says VIKKI “I don't seem to be there for very
long, because my work schedule is so full, but | am not complaining, |
am getting the best of both worlds at the moment and on both sides
of the Atlantic too!

This latest album from VIKKH CARR takes its title from.the song
that marked her début in the British ChartsIT MUST BE HIM. The
eleven other songs included, will introduce the new enthusiast to some
of the many different aspects of this talented vocalist, and establish
her even further in the hearts of her confirmed followers, for the magic
of VIKKI CARR is really SOMETHING!
